mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, actor_subject_id, target_subject_id, action, decision, reason_code, occurred_at FROM ( SELECT id, workspace_id, actor_subject_id, target_subject_id, action, decision, reason_code, occurred_at FROM ainer_workspace_authorization_audit UNION ALL SELECT id, workspace_id, actor_subject_id, target_subject_id, action, decision, reason_code, occurred_at FROM ainer_workspace_authorization_audit_archive ) audit WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.delete: WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id, workspace_id, actor_subject_id, target_subject_id, action, decision, reason_code, occurred_at FROM ainer_workspace_authorization_audit WHERE occurred_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY occurred_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), archived AS ( INSERT INTO ainer_workspace_authorization_audit_archive ( id, workspace_id, actor_subject_id, target_subject_id, action, decision, reason_code, occurred_at, archived_at ) SELECT id, workspace_id, actor_subject_id, target_subject_id, action, decision, reason_code, occurred_at, #{archivedAt} FROM candidates ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id ) DELETE FROM ainer_workspace_authorization_audit hot USING candidates WHERE hot.id = candidates.id AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived WHERE archived.id = hot.id) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ainer_workspace_authorization_audit_archive archive WHERE archive.id = hot.id ) )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ainer_workspace_authorization_audit) AS hot, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ainer_workspace_authorization_audit_archive) AS archived, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT decision, occurred_at FROM ainer_workspace_authorization_audit UNION ALL SELECT decision, occurred_at FROM ainer_workspace_authorization_audit_archive ) decisions WHERE decision = 'DENIED' AND occurred_at >= #{deniedSince} ) AS denied_in_window, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ainer_workspace workspace WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ainer_workspace_member member WHERE member.workspace_id = workspace.id AND member.role = 'OWNER' AND member.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ) AS ownerless_workspaces, (SELECT MIN(occurred_at) FROM ainer_workspace_authorization_audit) AS oldest_hot_at
